title: Diploma In Tourism And Hospitality Management (Level 5)
description: A comprehensive programme designed to develop advanced knowledge and practical skills essential for success in the tourism and hospitality industry.
longDescription: This diploma equips learners with the competencies required to manage and lead within the dynamic global tourism and hospitality sector. It explores key principles such as operations, customer service, strategic management, and sustainable practices that drive industry success. Learners gain insights into the latest trends, technologies, and challenges shaping travel, tourism, and hospitality worldwide. The course emphasises the integration of theoretical knowledge with real-world applications to prepare graduates for leadership roles. Upon completion, participants are prepared to contribute effectively to service excellence, business growth, and organisational performance in the sector.
courseDetails: The programme covers a range of critical topics, from hospitality operations and service quality to strategic planning and destination management. Students will explore marketing strategies, event planning, and sustainability approaches that enhance industry competitiveness. Emphasis is placed on developing managerial, analytical, and decision-making skills essential for tourism and hospitality roles. The course also encourages innovation and adaptability to meet evolving customer expectations and global industry standards. The Diploma in Tourism and Hospitality Management (Level 5) provides a strong foundation in key business, service, and operational skills needed for careers in travel, tourism, and hospitality. It prepares learners for leadership and managerial positions in a rapidly changing global marketplace.

The Diploma in Tourism and Hospitality Management (Level 5) provides a strong foundation in key business, service, and operational skills needed for careers in travel, tourism, and hospitality. It prepares learners for leadership and managerial positions in a rapidly changing global marketplace.
entry: For entry into Level 5 Diploma in Tourism and Hospitality Management, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

outcomes: Understand the structure, operations, and strategic functions within the tourism and hospitality industry.
Analyse global market trends and their impact on hospitality services and tourism development.
Apply customer service principles to enhance guest experiences and build brand loyalty.
Evaluate the role of marketing, branding, and digital communication in tourism and hospitality businesses.
Develop strategic plans to manage tourism destinations, events, and hospitality enterprises.
Implement sustainable and ethical practices within tourism and hospitality operations.
Apply financial and resource management techniques to ensure business efficiency and profitability.
Demonstrate leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills relevant to the sector.
